_comment: The Map's charts (lib/shell/pbsLayout, shell/PbsChart): where every box sits and how its words are set. Sizes are SVG units of the chart's own drawing, which scales to the screen. Colours are theme.json's pbs group.
_comment-rows: Space between one row of the tree and the next: from the root down to the bus line, from the bus down to the branches, from the branches down to their first kid. branch-drop is how far a branch's spine runs down before it turns to its kids.
_comment-footnote: The scope note under the tree: its rule sits rule-gap below the lowest box, its first line note-drop under the rule and each line line-pitch apart, and end-pad closes the drawing (with no note, no rule, and the drawing closes end-pad below the lowest box).
_comment-levels: A box's width, its least height (it grows when its words wrap), the size of its Arabic name and of its English line, and how strong that English is drawn. A branch's kids stand kid-indent in from its column's edge.
_comment-text: How words are set in a box. Words stay pad from its sides, hint-pad where a › hint sits at its left, and pad-y above and below. Line heights are shares of the size (the Arabic one leaves room for its marks); sub-gap separates the name from its English; drop is how far under a line's middle its baseline sits, in ems. glyph-em is a letter's width, in ems, until the real font can be measured (and in tests).
